model.name: BUG18: clicking a FILE in a room shows the PARENT collection in the drawer, not the file detail (regression)
model.description: REGRESSION (Tron screenshot): clicking a FILE in a room (e.g. 16CDAA25...jpeg in 'Jesus Munich' Files) shows the PARENT 'Files(2)' collection in the detail drawer instead of the file's OWN detail. file-detail-on-click is mis-wired to render the parent collection.
model.acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a file shows the FILEs own detail (not parent collection). From file detail, click NAVIGATES to BROWSE-FILE (file browser) with the file HIGHLIGHTED, enabling the scenario MONACO editor. All pieces exist — REWIRE.
